tasks.title: Free-space path loss
tasks.solution: FSPL = 20·lg(d_km) + 20·lg(f_MHz) + 32.44. Doubling the distance or the frequency adds +6 dB.

tasks.title: Link margin
tasks.solution: Margin = P_tx + G_tx + G_rx − FSPL − S_rx (the sensitivity is negative, so we add its absolute value). The minimum is 10–15 dB for fading, 20 dB is comfortable.

tasks.title: Fresnel zone
tasks.solution: r₁ = 17.32·√(d_km/(4·f_GHz)) at the midpoint of the path. 60% of this radius must be clear of obstacles.
